page_title: MAR 3-2 TOU | Marseille v Toulouse 06/04/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's the end of the match.
90+5' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Toulouse, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
90+5' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Bilal Nadir (Marseille) was quite harsh and Jeremie Pignard didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
90+4' Marseille take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

90+3' Guillaume Restes makes a sensational save to thwart a great chance. A rebound falls to Jonathan Rowe (Marseille) inside the box and he strikes goalwards, but the ball ends up in the keeper's gloves instead of the right side of the target. Marseille have been awarded a corner kick.
90+1' Here's the change. Charlie Cresswell leaves the pitch and Warren Kamanzi (Toulouse) comes on as a substitute.
90+1' Roberto De Zerbi has decided to make a change. Bilal Nadir (Marseille) replaces Ismael Bennacer.
90+1' Substitution. Amar Dedic (Marseille) replaces Mason Greenwood.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.

90' Cristian Casseres (Toulouse) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Jeremie Pignard no option but to blow his whistle. Marseille win a free kick.
87' CHANCE! Mason Greenwood finds Luis Henrique (Marseille) with a sweet pass, but he can't find the target as his effort from inside the box goes just wide of the left post!
86' Noah Edjouma (Toulouse) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent. Marseille are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
83' Marseille failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
82' Adrien Rabiot (Marseille) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. Marseille will take a corner kick.
80' What a chance that is! Vincent Sierro (Toulouse) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a pass on the edge of the box. His attempt goes just over the bar.
78' Marseille quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

78' Ulisses Garcia (Marseille) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety. Marseille have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
76' Substitution. Quentin Merlin walks off the pitch and Ulisses Garcia (Marseille) comes on as a substitute.
76' 3 - 2 A cross from the free kick is whipped deep into the box by Cristian Casseres and Vincent Sierro (Toulouse) gets in a shot, sending the ball inside the right post. 3:2.
75' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Jaydee Canvot (Toulouse) comes onto the pitch for Djibril Sidibe.
75' Carles Martinez has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Noah Edjouma (Toulouse) replacing Shavy Babicka.
75' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Yann Gboho leaves the pitch and Joshua King (Toulouse) comes on.
74' Jeremie Pignard couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Adrien Rabiot (Marseille) and blew his whistle. Toulouse have a free kick.
73' The up-to-date shots on target statistics – 3:2.
71' The referee looks satisfied after his VAR review and duly disallows the goal for offside. The Marseille players look gutted.
71' The Marseille players joy may have been justified, because referee Jeremie Pignard is going use VAR to determine whether it was offside.
70' GOAL DISALLOWED! Controversy and anger as Jonathan Rowe (Marseille) has a goal ruled out, incredibly, for offside.
68' Cristian Casseres (Toulouse) has tested the patience of referee Jeremie Pignard and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
64' 3 - 1 What a hit! Adrien Rabiot (Marseille) shows good composure inside the box to fire a first-time shot inside the right post. 3:1.
61' Charlie Cresswell (Toulouse) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Jeremie Pignard blows for a foul. Marseille get a free kick.
60' Vincent Sierro (Toulouse) runs onto a good long pass and tries his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort flies high over the bar.
60' Djibril Sidibe (Toulouse) is caught offside!
59' Cristian Casseres (Toulouse) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
57' 2 - 1 Goal! Ismael Bennacer plays a short, square pass into the path of Mason Greenwood (Marseille), who bends a shot straight into the roof of the net to make it 2:1. Fabulous goal!
56' Roberto De Zerbi prepares a substitution. Derek Cornelius is replaced by Pol Lirola (Marseille).
56' Substitution. Neal Maupay leaves the pitch and is replaced by Jonathan Rowe (Marseille).
56' Frank Magri (Toulouse) earns the yellow card.
55' Gabriel Suazo (Toulouse) tries to find Yann Gboho, but he puts too much power on the through ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Marseille.
53' Michael Murillo (Marseille) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Jeremie Pignard blows his whistle for an infringement. A free kick to Toulouse.
53' Quentin Merlin (Marseille) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post.
52' Geronimo Rulli displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Frank Magri (Toulouse) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
50' Mark McKenzie (Toulouse) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Jeremie Pignard has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle. Marseille earn a free kick.
49' Marseille control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
45' Jeremie Pignard has a clear sight and sees a foul from Cristian Casseres (Toulouse). A free kick is awarded to Marseille.
43' A poorly executed mid-range free kick by Ismael Bennacer (Marseille) as he fails to deliver a decent cross.
43' Foul! Djibril Sidibe (Toulouse) is penalised for pulling back his opponent. Marseille are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
40' Ismael Bennacer (Marseille) makes a rough challenge and Jeremie Pignard blows his whistle for a foul. It's a free kick to Toulouse in a dangerous position.
38' Shavy Babicka (Toulouse) weaves through the defence and gets one-on-one with the keeper, but fails to score.
37' Neal Maupay (Marseille) covers his face with his hands after spurning a great chance. The ball rebounded to him and his close-range header went a whisker wide of the right post.

37' Guillaume Restes makes a brilliant save! Quentin Merlin (Marseille) easily weaves through the defence and fires the ball from mid-range. His effort goes straight under the crossbar but is saved by the keeper!
36' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
35' A quickly taken corner by Marseille.
32' Shavy Babicka (Toulouse) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Jeremie Pignard had an easy-decision to make.
32' The foul by Shavy Babicka (Toulouse) was seen by Jeremie Pignard who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
31' Shavy Babicka (Toulouse) dribbles into the box, but Geronimo Rulli is quick enough to come off his line and stop him.
30' Marseille players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.
28' 1 - 1 Frank Magri (Toulouse) heads the ball into the top left corner after a splendid cross. This timely header produces a wonderful moment.
27' Ismael Bennacer (Marseille) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass. The ball goes out of play and Toulouse will have a goal kick.
26' Shavy Babicka (Toulouse) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
24' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
21' 1 - 0 An unfortunate own goal is conceded by Gabriel Suazo (Toulouse), who attempted to smack the ball away, but instead he sends it inside the right post of his own goal.
20' Frank Magri (Toulouse) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and shoots. His poorly placed shot flies well wide of the right post.
18' Valentin Rongier (Marseille) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul. Toulouse have been awarded a free kick.
17' Frank Magri (Toulouse) commits a foul and Jeremie Pignard immediately signals a free kick. Marseille have a free kick.

16' That's unlucky! Adrien Rabiot (Marseille) side steps a tackle after receiving a pass, advances then hits a booming shot from mid-range which only rises at the last second to fly just over the bar.
15' Michael Murillo (Marseille) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
14' A pass by Shavy Babicka (Toulouse) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
12' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Adrien Rabiot (Marseille). Jeremie Pignard saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Toulouse.
10' Toulouse score a goal, but referee Jeremie Pignard has now indicated he wants to check if the goal can stand using VAR!
9' Frank Magri (Toulouse) has a goal ruled out for offside!
8' Quentin Merlin (Marseille) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
7' Mark McKenzie (Toulouse) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Jeremie Pignard blows for a foul. Marseille will take a free kick.
5' Neal Maupay (Marseille) makes a run into the box in an attempt to get onto a long through ball, but one of the opponents comes up with a vital clearance.
4' Flag goes up against Adrien Rabiot (Marseille) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.

3' Vincent Sierro (Toulouse) reacts well near the penalty spot to connect with the resulting corner, but fails to direct his header into the back of the net. The ball goes well wide of the right post.
3' Gabriel Suazo (Toulouse) is about to take a corner kick.

2' Aron Donnum (Toulouse) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger. The ball goes out of play. Toulouse are awarded a corner kick.
2' Derek Cornelius (Marseille) trips an opposition player and Jeremie Pignard signals a foul. There is a free kick near the sideline to Toulouse.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are on the pitch and Toulouse will have the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Jeremie Pignard.
